description: Application-owned, offline-only handoff for one explicitly selected DC Corporate Registration active-record package and its validated metadata/count preflight receipt.
redirect_policy: No HTTP requests, redirects, discovery, or automated acquisition are permitted.
retry: No automatic retry. Inspect the durable receipt and replace or correct the explicitly selected package.
checkpoint: One UUID operation owns its start record, input snapshot, operation-scoped independently verified release, and terminal receipt.
idempotency: Input SHA-256 values and the source connector release identity bind each operation. Re-running creates a distinct operation and never changes a source or national current pointer.
cancellation: Cancellation is cooperative. The operation records CANCELLED and removes only its unpublished snapshot and operation-scoped release; selected inputs are never modified.
retention_profile: Operator inputs remain under data/imports. Privacy-minimized evidence and receipts remain local-review-only until an explicit retention action.
